PluginData.Author: CometWorks
PluginData.Tooltip: Server rules of the Octahedron world
PluginData.Description: Server rules that only the Octahedron world uses: the economy stations' refill, refill containers, braking at the world's edge, starter ships from the stations' hologram tables, block limits for welded projections and shipyard welding in the stations' safe zones. Loaded from a checkout of the worlds repo as a local dev folder; it has no hub entry.
